summary.text: Jeremy Haroldson is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 4, serving since January 2021, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jeremy Haroldson was born in Wheatland, Wyoming, earned a degree in power plant technology from Bismarck State College in 2006 and earned a degree in Biblical theology from Global University in 2016.
Haroldson's career experience includes working as senior pastor of Impact Ministries.
Haroldson assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 4, 2021, succeeding Dan Kirkbride.

For 2025-2026, Haroldson's committee assignments include the House Appropriations Committee, the House Rules and Procedure Committee, the Management Council Committee and the Joint Appropriations Committee.
